methodology: Monte Carlo estimates using the weekly Power Index, verified final results, a 14-week schedule and a 6-team playoff bracket. The mapping from roster value to scoring distributions is a modeling assumption, not an empirically calibrated guarantee.

1.powerConnectionNarrative: Projected finish #1 versus Power Index #1. The forecast also includes completed results, schedule and simulated weekly scoring variance. The difference alone does not identify a causal driver.

modelFactors.volatilityImpactNarrative: With a stable profile (22.1/100), the model applies a weekly scoring standard deviation of ±12.9 pts. The top 3 starters account for 42.8% of starting redraft value and RBs represent 46.7%. In 10,000 simulations, this volatility models an expected weekly floor of 117.0 pts (10th percentile) and a shootout ceiling of 150.2 pts (90th percentile).
